Milestone 9 (project-pages): adds a figure to four project home pages. Each `experiments/figure.py` parses the committed `results.txt` (no retyped numbers) and writes an SVG. No experiment code or results changed. `python site/build.py` prints `ok`.

- jitter-twin: stability threshold vs delay
- lens-twin: range ratio vs h/R
- range-twin: steps to tolerance vs initial error (log-log)
- slip-twin: understeer turn radius vs speed

Also notes them in the PROJECTS.md progress line and adds the run record.
